title: Charred Creamy Uruguayan Beurre-Noisette Casserole
description: A rich, low-carb-friendly casserole featuring charred eggplant, creamy beurre-noisette sauce, and a sweet glaze. Perfect for a romantic dinner date night.

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.notes: use a sugar substitute for low-carb option

instructions: Cut the eggplants into 1-inch cubes and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the eggplants in the oven for 20 minutes, or until lightly charred.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the cream by half and stir in the grated cheese until melted.
Stir in the sugar, Dijon mustard, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped cilantro and stir to combine.
In a separate saucepan, caramelize the onions over low heat for 30 minutes.
Mince the garlic cloves and add to the saucepan with the onions.
Stir in the balsamic vinegar and cook for 1 minute more.
To assemble the casserole, place the roasted eggplant in a baking dish, followed by the creamy beurre-noisette sauce, and then the caramelized onion mixture.
Top with the glaze and sprinkle with additional cheese if desired.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
